title: What If You Got Trapped Under the Ocean With Your CRUSH?
tags: what if you were trapped under the ocean
description:
You went fishing with your crush, the boat flipped, and you both sank. A mermaid saved you. Now you're trapped in a city at the bottom of the ocean, and the only thing keeping you alive is a bubble of air. The bubble is running out, and the mermaids have very strict rules about humans who have seen their kingdom.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Would you stay under the ocean with the mermaids or go back to the surface?
2) How long do you think you could hold your breath underwater?

Subscribe so you don't miss the next "What If". Gus is not done embarrassing himself in front of Lia.

Real facts in this episode:

• Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air (about 1,500 m/s vs 340 m/s).
https://dosits.org/tutorials/science/tutorial-speed

• In January 1493, Christopher Columbus wrote that he saw three mermaids. They were almost certainly manatees, and he said they were not as pretty as the paintings.
https://www.history.com/this-day-in-history/january-9/columbus-mistakes-manatees-for-mermaids

• Every 10 meters underwater adds about one more atmosphere of pressure (NOAA).
https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/?p=1842

• About three out of four animals in the open ocean can make their own light (MBARI, 2017).
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5379559/

• Almost three quarters of the ocean floor has still never been mapped in detail (NOAA, 2025).
https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/?p=1879
